data: Tesla's fiscal 2024 revenue (year ended December 31, 2024) was $97,690 million, or about $97.7 billion, while NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 revenue (year ended January 28, 2024) was $60,922 million, or about $60.9 billion. Tesla is therefore the larger of the two, at roughly 1.6 times NVIDIA's revenue ($97,690 / $60,922 ≈ 1.60). Note that the two fiscal years are not aligned: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024 ended almost a year before Tesla's, so it mostly covers calendar 2023. Tesla's calendar 2023 revenue was $96,773 million, which would make the gap about 1.6 times on that basis too.
